_comment: Single source of truth for the game build, the addresses used by the loader,
and the ABI/hook declarations that tools/frida/gen_zig.py turns into Zig.
Every object may carry a "_doc" string: the generator emits it as a Zig `///`
doc comment on the corresponding declaration, so documentation travels with
the data into the generated manifest.
On a NEW game version: copy this file, update version/sha256, then re-run the
re-location order in tools/frida/AGENTS.md and replace the RVAs.
Run `uv run python tools/frida/verify.py --exe <path>` afterwards: it fails
loudly on any drift. All addresses are RVAs (VA - 0x140000000).
The schema (types, enums, signatures, structs) and the full struct-field
type vocabulary -- including what `str`/`count` mean -- are documented in
tools/frida/AGENTS.md under 'Descriptor schema'. Field types are one of:
_doc: Game build and ABI descriptor for the loader. Addresses, hooks and layouts below are build-specific and must be re-verified for every patch.

types.name: Engine
types._doc: The top-level engine: owns the renderer, input, and the active World through the front-end/back-end factories. Borrowed; never owned by a mod.

types.name: World
types._doc: A running match. Constructed when the factory creates ObjectFactoryType.world; owns the simulation (sim at +0x1CB0), teams, managers and the resolved match configuration.

types.name: WorldSim
types._doc: The simulation owned by a World (at World+0x1CB0). Owns the fixed-timestep clock (physics at 25 Hz) and drives per-frame/per-step updates.

types.name: MatchSetup
types._doc: Match configuration passed to the World constructor: map paths, mission name, commanders, game mode, AI settings and the mod list.

types.name: FrontEndFactoryStandard
types._doc: The front-end factory whose first virtual method builds game objects. The object is just { vptr; Engine* owner; } and is not a singleton.

types.name: FortsShell
types._doc: The top-level application object (global Shell_ptr). Owns the time keepers, the state stack and the frame loop; its primary vtable (FortsShell_Primary) slot 0 is the per-frame Execute.

types.name: InputManager
types._doc: DirectInput8 + Win32 input manager (global InputManager_ptr). Polled once per frame by Input_Update.

types.name: Renderer
types._doc: The OpenGL renderer singleton. Its vtable is built at runtime at Renderer_vtable; slot +0x8 is Renderer_Present (glFlush + gdi32 SwapBuffers).

types.name: Control
types._doc: Base UI control of the game's own C++ widget toolkit (see structs.control). Screens are Lua tables built into Control trees; the toolkit is exposed to scripts through the Forts Scripting API's User Interface functions.

types.name: UiManager
types._doc: The UI/display manager singleton (global UiManager_ptr). Its +0x28 points at a display object that carries the win32 HWND and the GetClientRect-derived client size used to drive screen layout. This is the root the Lua UI functions resolve controls against.

enums.name: ObjectFactoryType
enums._doc: Object type ids accepted by ObjectFactory_Create. Non-exhaustive on purpose: the build can add ids and most are unnamed, so any raw u32 remains representable via @enumFromInt. Only `world` is confidently identified.

enums.name: ControlFrame
enums._doc: Reference frame for the Lua `SetControlFrame` / `worldRelative` UI state. FRAME_SCREEN/FRAME_WORLD/FRAME_CONTEXTMENU are defined in scripts/forts.lua; the value is persistent per script until changed. Controls created with worldRelative=true use FRAME_WORLD.

values.name: world
values._doc: World space; positions are relative to world objects.

World_Execute._doc: World::Execute — World vtable slot 3 (offset 0x18). The whole-match update, called once per rendered engine frame with the frame delta. The widest hook: wraps the entire world update.

World_Install._doc: World::Install — World vtable slot 1 (offset 0x8). Activates a freshly constructed world: loads the map, spawns teams/players, and publishes the global World pointer.

World_RestoredFromPause._doc: World::RestoredFromPause — World vtable slot 2 (offset 0x10). Runs when the match resumes from a pause. NOTE: on the traced builds this slot is never observed to fire.

World_DeletingDtor._doc: World's scalar deleting destructor — World vtable slot 0 (offset 0x0). Destroys the world and, when _flags & 1, frees its storage. Returns `this`, already freed on the deleting path.

World_ctor._doc: World::World — World constructor. Called by ObjectFactory_Create for ObjectFactoryType.world, with the engine from the factory's owner and the MatchSetup. Returns `this`.

World_dtor._doc: World::~World — the non-deleting destructor. Runs member teardown; the deleting variant (World_DeletingDtor) calls into this and then frees. Not present in the primary vtable.

World_Sim_Update_Tick._doc: WorldSim::Update — sim vtable slot 2 (offset 0x10). Advances the simulation for one frame: the fixed-step loop (physics at 25 Hz) and the Lua Update/SystemUpdate dispatch. Good for once-per-frame sim work.

World_Sim_Reset._doc: WorldSim::Reset — sim vtable slot 1 (offset 0x8). Re-initialises the simulation state (e.g. on a match restart/reload).

World_Sim_ctor._doc: WorldSim::WorldSim — sim constructor. Constructs the simulation owned by `world`. Returns `this`.

World_Sim_dtor._doc: WorldSim's scalar deleting destructor — sim vtable slot 0 (offset 0x0). Destroys the simulation and, when _flags & 1, frees its storage.

ObjectFactory_Create._doc: FrontEndFactoryStandard::Create — factory vtable slot 0 (offset 0x0). Builds one game object of the requested ty and returns it, or null for unhandled ids. For ty == ObjectFactoryType.world this leads to World_ctor.

FortsShell_Execute._doc: FortsShell::Execute — FortsShell primary vtable slot 0. The top-level per-frame update: advances the time keepers, polls input (Input_Update), updates the managers, runs the active state frame (Shell_StateFrame) and the FPS limiter. Runs in menus AND in a match, once per rendered frame. This is the app-frame counterpart to World_Sim_Update_Tick.

Input_Update._doc: InputManager::Update — per-frame input poll (DirectInput8 IDirectInputDevice8::GetDeviceState plus Win32 GetKeyState), called from FortsShell_Execute. `this` is the global InputManager_ptr. Hook onEnter to observe or zero the keyboard/mouse state (see structs.input) and so filter gameplay input; the state is copied to the previous-frame snapshot first, then consumed.

Renderer_Present._doc: OpenGL present (renderer vtable slot +0x8). Runs once per rendered frame after the game's draw calls and before its glFlush/SwapBuffers; hook onEnter to draw after the game's own UI.

WndProc._doc: The main window procedure (window class 'Forts'). The Win32 message hook point: return early to swallow a message. The game reads keyboard/mouse from DirectInput (Input_Update), not WM_KEYDOWN, so also filtering DirectInput is required to stop gameplay input.

HUD_Update._doc: HUD::Update — once per controller per frame. Force PlayerController+0x47 back to 1 in onEnter to keep the DebugPanel open (see structs.playercontroller.debug_overlay).

SoftwareTimeKeeper_ctor._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper::SoftwareTimeKeeper — writes the vtable at object+0x0 and zeroes the time at +0x8. Called from the WorldSim ctor with the address WorldSim+0x18C0.

SoftwareTimeKeeper_Set._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper vtable slot +0x0: stores the float argument at object+0x8. Hook it to observe/override the per-step time write.

SoftwareTimeKeeper_Get._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper vtable slot +0x8: returns the float at object+0x8. Read-only accessor the tick uses for scheduled effects / time-limit checks.

Ui_WidgetFactory._doc: The UI widget factory: maps a Type string ('Control', 'Button', 'Static', 'StaticWindow', 'Text', 'TextButton', 'EditBox', 'Window', 'WindowFrame', 'ListBox', 'TabbedPanel', 'SliderBar', 'DropDownMenu', 'Graph'; case-insensitive) to a constructor and returns the new control, or null for an unknown type. Per-type allocation sizes are in tools/frida/AGENTS.md.

Ui_FindControl._doc: Control-tree name lookup: returns the control whose name (MSVC std::string at Control+0x128) matches, searching children recursively when `recursive` is nonzero.

Ui_AddChild._doc: Appends a child control to a parent (invokes the child's SetParent vtable slot then pushes it onto the parent's children vector).

Ui_AddChildFront._doc: Prepends a child control (drawn-first / front of the children vector).

Scripts_Update_Dispatch._doc: Lua script dispatcher (SystemUpdate + Update) run once per fixed step. Not wired to a relay yet.

Scripts_OnUpdate_Event._doc: Lua "OnUpdate" event, run once per frame. Not wired to a relay yet.

Scripts_EndFrame._doc: Lua end-of-frame bookkeeping. Not wired to a relay yet.

World_DeletingDtor._doc: World scalar deleting destructor (vtable slot 0). See signatures.World_DeletingDtor.

World_Sim_dtor._doc: WorldSim scalar deleting destructor (sim vtable slot 0). See signatures.World_Sim_dtor.

World_Sim_slot18._doc: WorldSim vtable slot 3 (offset 0x18). Purpose not yet established; not wired to a relay.

FortsShell_Execute._doc: FortsShell::Execute (FortsShell primary vtable slot 0). Top-level per-frame update; runs in menus and matches. See signatures.FortsShell_Execute.

Shell_StateFrame._doc: FortsShell primary vtable slot 1. Present + per-frame state tick, invoked from FortsShell_Execute. The real per-frame draw happens here via Renderer_Present.

App_MainLoop._doc: Top-level application loop (the real WinMain body, after 'Running shell'): pumps PeekMessageW/GetMessageW/TranslateMessage/DispatchMessageW, then calls FortsShell_Execute each iteration. Contains the 'Start Main Loop' / 'End Main Loop' traces. Not itself per-frame (one call per app run); use FortsShell_Execute or Renderer_Present to count frames.

Input_Update._doc: InputManager::Update — per-frame input poll (DirectInput8 + GetKeyState). See signatures.Input_Update.

Renderer_Present._doc: OpenGL renderer present: glFlush, and when do_swap != 0 GetDC(hwnd)+SwapBuffers(gdi32)+ReleaseDC, then glClear. Reached once per rendered frame as (*Renderer_vtable[1])(1) from every state's Execute. Not wired to a relay.

WndProc._doc: Main window procedure for the 'Forts' window class. Handles WM_CLOSE/WM_DESTROY/WM_SIZE/WM_ACTIVATE/WM_SYSKEYUP/WM_MOUSEWHEEL/WM_IME_*/WM_SIZING/WM_TIMER and routes WM_CHAR/WM_IME_CHAR text to the InputManager (FUN_140514750); everything else to DefWindowProc. See signatures.WndProc.

LowLevelKeyboardProc._doc: WH_KEYBOARD_LL hook proc installed by FUN_140071ee0 via SetWindowsHookExA(13,...) while the window is active, used to catch keys globally (works in exclusive fullscreen). A second keyboard interception point besides DirectInput.

HUD_Update._doc: HUD::Update(HUD* this, float dt), HUD = PlayerController+0xE10. Once per controller per frame; drives the HUD/control tree and calls HUD_DebugPanel + HUD_DebugList. Force PlayerController+0x47 back to 1 in onEnter to keep the DebugPanel open. See signatures.HUD_Update.

HUD_DebugPanel._doc: HUD debug overlay builder. Gated on PlayerController+0x47: when nonzero it shows the DebugPanel (Static) and fills the DebugListBox with live lines via the '%d %d:%02d %.0f fps %S' / 'frame %d cursor %.2f, %.2f' formats. Force PC+0x47=1 here to open DebugPanel in any match.

HUD_DebugList._doc: Positions/lays out the DebugListBox control (and peers) above the controller's debug overlay region. Called from HUD_Update.

PlayerController_ctor._doc: PlayerController::PlayerController (size 0xF50). Sets PC+0x47=(World+0x1b64==2) and builds the control tree via PlayerController_CreateHud. Called from World_ctor at World+0x1CE0.

PlayerController_CreateHud._doc: Builds the PlayerController control tree: looks up the root control and resolves named children including DebugPanel (Static), DebugListBox (ListBox), HUDObserver, ObserverPauseButton, Play/Forward/Timeline/SpeedUp/SpeedDown/Speed (the observer player bar), DebugPanel, Movie, Subtitle, HUD, HudPanel.

Console_BindKeys._doc: Binds the in-game console keys: ToggleConsole ('~' 0x29), ToggleConsole2 (Enter 0x3D), ToggleConsoleFullscreen ('~'+Shift), Previous/NextCommand, AutoComplete, KeyEnter, KeyBackspace, Paste. Console is a real Console subsystem, separate from the DebugPanel overlay.

Lua_RegisterApi._doc: Registers the entire Forts Lua API (594 C functions) into the script manager's lua_State (FUN_140066d00(manager) = *(manager+0x228)). Each binding is an inline block: public name + '_Name' + C function pointer + arity flag; installed through Lua_InstallBinding. The global byte DAT_1407dd684 selects direct public-name binding (0) versus '_Name' plus an auto-generated Lua LogCall wrapper (nonzero). Called by each script-type initializer (mission/mod/AI). See signatures.Lua_RegisterApi.

Lua_InstallBinding._doc: The generic binding installer: (refObject, name, trampoline, nupvalues, ...). Internally lua_pushcclosure + lua_setfield. Wraps the real C function pointer as a single upvalue carried by a per-signature trampoline (e.g. FUN_1400e3510). Use this to add a new native function to a script state: get the lua_State, call with your lua_CFunction.

Script_ContextPush._doc: ScriptContext push(name): pushes the current script/event context (sets the global CurrentScriptName and appends to ScriptContextQueue, max depth 10). Powers GetCurrentScript/GetCurrentCall; called by every event dispatcher.

Script_Dofile._doc: The scripts' dofile(): loads and executes a Lua chunk in LuaCurrentState. Only valid at initialisation; after scripts/forts.lua succeeds it also loads scripts/forts_dlc3.lua. On error logs 'Error: executing dofile %s: %s'.

Lua_CallScript._doc: C implementation of the Lua CallScript(name, teamId, func, args...) binding: finds the named script and calls a function in it. Errors via 'Error: %s:%s Callscript(...) -> %s:%s: %s'.

Lua_ExecuteInScript._doc: C implementation of the Lua ExecuteInScript(teamId, script, instruction) binding.

Lua_SendScriptEvent.prologue: 48 83 ec 38 c6 44 24 20 00 e8 62 5d 03 00 48 83 c4 38 c3 cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc cc
Lua_SendScriptEvent._doc: C implementation (thin wrapper) of the Lua SendScriptEvent(...) binding; dispatches a named event to scripts. Forwards to FUN_1400c70e0.

Lua_GetScriptValue._doc: C implementation of the Lua GetScriptValue binding (read a value from another script's data).

Lua_SetScriptValue._doc: C implementation of the Lua SetScriptValue binding (write a value into another script's data).

SoftwareTimeKeeper_Set._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper::Set (vtable slot +0x0): MOVSS [rcx+8], xmm1. See signatures.SoftwareTimeKeeper_Set.

SoftwareTimeKeeper_Get._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper::Get (vtable slot +0x8): MOVSS xmm0, [rcx+8]. See signatures.SoftwareTimeKeeper_Get.

Ui_WidgetFactory._doc: UiWidgetFactory(const char* Type) -> Control*. Case-insensitive Type dispatch. Allocates and constructs one of Control/Button/Graph/Static/StaticWindow/Text/TextButton/EditBox/Window(BorderedWindow)/WindowFrame/ListBox/TabbedPanel/SliderBar/DropDownMenu. See signatures.Ui_WidgetFactory.

Ui_BuildFromLua._doc: Builds a UI control/screen object graph from a Lua chunk and (when requested) loads the sibling strings.lua. Returns the new screen object or null. Called by the engine's screen ctors and by Ui_LoadControl. Not wired to a relay.

Lua_LoadFile._doc: Lua_LoadFile(session, path, keepGlobals, customLoader, fromMemory, flag): loads and runs a Lua file through the pack-aware virtual filesystem (Lua 5.1.1 / LuaPlus) into a script state. Sandboxes the environment: strips and restores loadfile/require/module/package and gates globals; logs 'Error loading file %s: %s'. Anchor for the script-file loading path.

Ui_FindControl._doc: Recursive control name lookup. name lives at Control+0x128 (MSVC std::string), children vector at Control+0xD0. See signatures.Ui_FindControl.

Ui_AddChild._doc: Append a child control. See signatures.Ui_AddChild.

Ui_AddChildFront._doc: Prepend a child control. See signatures.Ui_AddChildFront.

Ui_CenterOnDesignSize._doc: Centres a screen root on the 1066.67x600 design canvas using the display object at UiManager_ptr+0x28 (client width/height at +0x6C/+0x70).

Ui_LoadControl._doc: Lua LoadControl(filename, parent): loads a control tree from a ui/**/*.lua file and adds it under the named parent control (empty = active screen root). For OnControlActivated to fire for its Button/TextButton controls, call SetButtonCallback on each.

Ui_AddTextControl._doc: Lua AddTextControl(parent, name, text, anchor, pos, worldRelative, style): creates a Text control (factory alloc 0x880).

Ui_AddTextButtonControl._doc: Lua AddTextButtonControl(parent, name, text, anchor, pos, worldRelative, style): creates a TextButton (alloc 0x930). OnControlActivated fires when pressed (no SetButtonCallback needed).

Ui_AddButtonControl._doc: Lua AddButtonControl(parent, name, sprite, anchor, size, pos, style): creates a textured Button (alloc 0x3E8). OnControlActivated fires when pressed.

Ui_AddSpriteControl._doc: Lua AddSpriteControl(parent, name, sprite, anchor, size, pos, worldRelative): creates a Sprite control (Static/Graph variant).

Ui_ControlExists.prologue: 48 83 ec 28 44 8b 05 0d 83 74 00 e8 30 ed ff ff 48 85 c0 0f 95 c0 48 83 c4 28 c3 cc cc cc cc cc
Ui_ControlExists._doc: Lua ControlExists(parent, name): true when a control with that name exists under parent.

Ui_SetButtonCallback._doc: Lua SetButtonCallback(parent, name, int id): sets the numerical activation id on a control so it dispatches OnControlActivated. Required for Button/TextButton controls that came from LoadControl; AddButtonControl/AddTextButtonControl already dispatch. Installs an ICallbackTarget object (vtable PTR_vftable_1407c33b0) on the control.

Ui_SetControlText._doc: Lua SetControlText(parent, name, text): sets a Text/TextButton's content and re-evaluates dynamic layout under parent ('$id' prefixes a localised string). Also the C implementation shared by SetControlStyle/SetControlFrame/... helpers.

Ui_GetChildCount._doc: Lua GetChildCount(name): number of direct children of a control.

Ui_GetChildName._doc: Lua GetChildName(name, index): name of the nth child control.

Ui_EvaluateLayoutScript._doc: Lua EvaluateLayoutScript(parent, name, expression): evaluates a ScriptX/ScriptY/ScriptW/ScriptH layout mini-expression (e.g. 'MiddleX - MainPanel.x', 'ParentMiddleX', 'PrevVisibleSiblingBottom + 4').

Ui_ShowControl._doc: Lua ShowControl(parent, name, bool): shows/hides a control.

Ui_DeleteControl._doc: Lua DeleteControl(parent, name): destroys a control.

Ui_WorldToScreen._doc: Lua WorldToScreen(pos): world position -> screen position.

Ui_ScreenToWorld._doc: Lua ScreenToWorld(pos): screen position -> world position.

World._doc: World vtable base. Slots: 0 deleting dtor, 1 Install, 2 RestoredFromPause, 3 Execute.

WorldSim_primary._doc: WorldSim primary vtable. Slots: 0 deleting dtor, 1 Reset, 2 Update, 3 unknown.

WorldSim_secondary._doc: WorldSim secondary vtable (known by RVA only; targets not yet identified).

FortsShell_Primary._doc: FortsShell primary vtable (installed at object+0x0 by FortsShell ctor). Slots: 0 Execute (per-frame), 1 state frame/present, 2 unidentified Shell method @0x572BC0.

SoftwareTimeKeeper_Primary._doc: SoftwareTimeKeeper primary vtable. Base class TimeKeeper. Slot +0x0 stores the float time, slot +0x8 returns it; the WorldSim tick calls Get and Set through the embedded clock at WorldSim+0x18C0.

slots._doc: Set: store the float time at object+0x8.
Get: return the float time at object+0x8.

physics_clock.text: Starting physics clock at frame %d, time %.4f

Running_shell._doc: Emitted by WinMain right before App_MainLoop.

Renderer_CreatingContext._doc: Emitted by the OpenGL renderer init (Renderer_Init).

Renderer_VideoCard._doc: Emitted by renderer init with glGetString(GL_RENDERER).

WndProc_AltIntercept._doc: Emitted by WndProc when it swallows the Alt-key system message.

Vulkan_check._doc: Emitted by the renderer when probing the optional Vulkan backend (GL_NV_draw_vulkan_image interop). Anchor only; the Vulkan path is not modelled.

DebugPanel._doc: Name of the Static control that holds the debug overlay text; looked up by PlayerController_CreateHud and shown by PlayerController_DebugPanel.

DebugListBox._doc: Name of the ListBox control that lists the live debug lines (mod activation, sim frame, etc.).

ToggleDebugMode._doc: A config/action name for toggling debug mode (no code xref; likely a console/config key).

DebugPanel_fps._doc: DebugPanel line format (wide string): sim frame, mm:ss, fps, and the current speed as 'Nx' (the %S is the time keeper speed slot). This is where the game speed is displayed in the UI.

DebugPanel_cursor._doc: Second DebugPanel line (wide string), shown when the controller flag at PlayerController+0x53 is set.

IllegalGlobals.text: %d: illegal use of globals in %s, state should only be stored in the 'data' table to avoid desyncs
IllegalGlobals._doc: Script state guard: emitted by Scripts_Update_Dispatch when a script's global table grew, i.e. it stored state outside its 'data' table (which desyncs late joiners/replay seeks).

DofileAtInit.text: Error: executing dofile %s at run time; dofile must run at initialisation
DofileAtInit._doc: Emitted by Script_Dofile when a script calls the engine dofile() after initialisation.

ScriptCtxMaxDepth.text: Error attempting to push script context (%s): ScriptContext queue has exceeded maximum depth
ScriptCtxMaxDepth._doc: Emitted by Script_ContextPush when the ScriptContext queue (max depth 10) overflows, i.e. script->script recursion is too deep.

ScriptsFortsLua._doc: The Lua bootstrap every script dofile()s; Script_Dofile chains scripts/forts_dlc3.lua after it.

FortsLua._doc: Bare forts.lua name (Lua-side helpers such as ScheduleCall are defined here).

LogWrapperTemplate._doc: Template used by Lua_RegisterApi when DAT_1407dd684 is nonzero: generates a Lua LogCall wrapper around each '_Name' native binding.

CallScriptError._doc: Emitted by Lua_CallScript when a cross-script call raises.

ScriptContext.text: Error attempting to push script context
ScriptContext._doc: Prefix anchor for the ScriptContext subsystem.

LuaApi_LoadControl._doc: Lua UI API binding name (pair with _LoadControl at 0x6F43C8).

LuaApi_AddTextControl._doc: Lua UI API binding name (pair with _AddTextControl at 0x6F43E8).

LuaApi_AddTextButtonControl._doc: Lua UI API binding name (pair with _AddTextButtonControl at 0x6F4408).

LuaApi_AddContextButton._doc: Lua UI API binding name (pair with _AddContextButton at 0x6F4830).

LuaApi_SetControlFrame._doc: Lua UI API binding name (the SetControl* family spans 0x6F4528..0x6F4A80).

LuaApi_SetControlTextW._doc: Lua UI API binding name (wide-character variant).

LuaApi_GetControlFrame._doc: Lua UI API binding name (the GetControl* family spans 0x6F4550..0x6F47A8 plus 0x6FBCD0..).

UiType_control._doc: Widget factory Type string (case-insensitive). Factory compares it first; see Ui_WidgetFactory.

UiType_graph._doc: Widget factory Type string ('graph'; note a second short 'graph' literal exists in the image).

Ui_invalid_style.text: Error: invalid style %s used on control %s
Ui_invalid_style._doc: Emitted by the control factory when a Style not present in ui/styles.lua is requested.

Ui_serialize_ScriptX._doc: Serializer format used when dumping a control tree back to Lua (ScriptX/Y/W/H follow).

ScreenW._doc: Lua global (ScreenW) injected into each screen's state by Ui_BuildFromLua; frame width.

ScreenH._doc: Lua global (ScreenH) injected into each screen's state; frame height.

UiStylesLua._doc: Style table (Styles + Normal/Heading/Title/... definitions) loaded for the UI.

UiLayoutLua._doc: Layout constants (DefaultScale, MiddleX, Margin, Title, MainPanel, Buttons) loaded for the UI.

UiSpritesLua._doc: Sprite/animated-texture definitions (Sprites table) loaded for the UI.

UiHudScreen._doc: HUD screen definition (the in-match control tree).

UiStartupScreen._doc: Startup screen definition; loaded by the startup path.

World_ptr2._doc: Secondary pointer to the current World.

Renderer_vtable._doc: OpenGL renderer vtable base (built at runtime by renderer init). Slot +0x8 is Renderer_Present.

InputManager_ptr._doc: Global InputManager* polled by Input_Update every frame.

Shell_ptr._doc: Global FortsShell* (app object; primary vtable FortsShell_Primary).

Forts_hwnd._doc: Main window HWND used by Renderer_Present (GetDC/SwapBuffers).

ScriptList._doc: Pointer to the global std::vector<ScriptRecord> (load order; {begin,end,cap} at +0/+8/+16). Every event dispatcher iterates it. See structs.script_record.

ScriptContextQueue._doc: The ScriptContext queue (std::vector<ScriptRecord>, max depth 10); pushed by Script_ContextPush so GetCurrentScript/GetCurrentCall know the current script and event.

CurrentScriptName._doc: const char* of the event currently being dispatched (set by Script_ContextPush), e.g. "Update", "SystemUpdate", "OnUpdate".

LuaCurrentState._doc: The lua_State currently executing (used by Script_Dofile and the binding trampolines). The per-script state is also ScriptRecord+0x08. Lua 5.1.1 (PUC-Rio) is statically linked.

UiManager_ptr._doc: UI/display manager singleton. Its +0x28 points at a display object that owns the win32 HWND and the GetClientRect-derived client size (width/height as i32 at +0x48/+0x4C, as f32 at +0x6C/+0x70, and a flag at +0x7C). Root for the Lua UI functions and the design-canvas centring.

UiActiveScreen._doc: Selector for the screen the Lua UI functions operate on (0 = the HUD/match screen, 1/2 = front-end screens). Read by every Ui_* Lua binding; written when the active screen changes.

UiFlags._doc: UI activity flags. The Ui_* Lua bindings early-out unless bit 0x2 is set, so UI edits only apply while a UI screen is live.

LuaBindingMode._doc: Lua_RegisterApi binding mode: 0 binds each public API name directly; nonzero binds the '_Name' form and additionally auto-generates a Lua LogCall wrapper (see LogWrapperTemplate).

fields.name: hide_forts_during_truce
fields._doc: Hide forts while a truce is active.

fields.name: terrain
fields._doc: Owned TerrainManager (structs.terrain), constructed by World_ctor (call FUN_1401fb780) right after the sim; holds the resolved global Physics.Gravity/Physics.AirDrag and the world extent. Verified live: gravity 981, air_drag 0.4.

fields.name: match_manager
fields._doc: World+0x1CE0 = the PlayerController (structs.playercontroller, size 0xF50; built by PlayerController_ctor). Despite the legacy name it is the per-player controller; its +0x47 byte is the DebugPanel overlay gate and its +0xE10 field is the HUD (structs.hud).

match_setup.name: MatchSetup
match_setup._doc: Match configuration passed to the World constructor.

fields.name: threaded
fields._doc: Resolved Physics.Threaded: nonzero when the physics workers are used. Verified live: 1.

fields.name: angle_stress_primary
fields._doc: Resolved Physics.Limits.AngleStressPrimaryThreshold, converted to radians in the ctor. Verified live: 0.5236 (30 deg).

fields.name: clock
fields._doc: Inline SoftwareTimeKeeper (structs.software_time_keeper). NOT a pointer: the object itself begins here and its vptr is the first 8 bytes. The tick reads/writes its time via SoftwareTimeKeeper_Get/_Set.

input.name: InputManager
input._doc: DirectInput8 + Win32 input manager (global InputManager_ptr), polled once per frame by Input_Update. `keyboard_state`/`keyboard_prev` are raw 256-byte DIK scancode arrays (read as bytes, NOT NUL-terminated strings); a mod can read them to listen and zero `keyboard_state` plus the mouse fields inside Input_Update to filter input (e.g. while an overlay captures the mouse).

fields.name: keyboard_state
fields._doc: Current keyboard state, 256 DIK scancodes (nonzero = down). Raw byte array; not a C string.

fields.name: keyboard_prev
fields._doc: Previous frame's keyboard state (edge detection copy of keyboard_state). Raw byte array; not a C string.

fields.name: mouse_dx
fields._doc: Relative mouse X accumulated this frame.

fields.name: mouse_dy
fields._doc: Relative mouse Y accumulated this frame.

fields.name: ime_composing
fields._doc: Set on WM_IME_STARTCOMPOSITION, cleared on WM_IME_ENDCOMPOSITION.

playercontroller.name: PlayerController
playercontroller._doc: World+0x1CE0. Per-player controller (size 0xF50) built by PlayerController_ctor (FUN_140289e00) from World_ctor. Owns the debug overlay gate and a HUD sub-object.

fields.name: debug_overlay
fields._doc: Debug overlay gate. Set from (World+0x1b64==2), i.e. spectator only. When nonzero, HUD_DebugPanel shows the DebugPanel and fills the DebugListBox with the live debug lines (sim frame, mm:ss, fps, speed 'Nx'). It is re-evaluated every frame, so force this byte to 1 on entry to HUD_Update (or HUD_DebugPanel) to open the overlay in any match.

hud.name: HUD
hud._doc: PlayerController+0xE10. Per-controller HUD/control tree. HUD_Update (FUN_140190210) drives it every frame; its +0x40 points back at the owning World. Holds the debug overlay controls.

fields.name: debug_list_count
fields._doc: Number of debug lines currently requested.

script_record.name: ScriptRecord
script_record._doc: One entry of the global ScriptList vector (element size 0x90). Holds a script's own lua_State, its source path and the global-table snapshot used to detect state stored outside 'data'. Each record is an independent Lua VM for one script; events are dispatched to every active record by name.

fields.name: active
fields._doc: 1 when the script is loaded and should receive Update/SystemUpdate/events.

fields.name: name
fields._doc: MSVC std::string (SSO buffer at +0x10, size at +0x20, capacity at +0x28) holding the script path, e.g. 'mods/dlc3/script.lua' or 'maps/<map>/<map>.lua'. Raw std::string bytes, not a plain C string.

fields.name: short_name
fields._doc: Second MSVC std::string: the bare script name without path or extension, e.g. 'dlc_harpoon'.

fields.name: global_count
fields._doc: Global-table count snapshot used by the desync guard in Scripts_Update_Dispatch. A value of -1 means the guard is not armed for that script (neither the ==0 arm nor the >0 compare runs), which is what a normal mod script shows live.

software_time_keeper.name: SoftwareTimeKeeper
software_time_keeper._doc: Inline simulation clock (RTTI class SoftwareTimeKeeper, base TimeKeeper). Embedded in WorldSim at +0x18C0. Its vptr is written in place by SoftwareTimeKeeper_ctor, so the object lives inside WorldSim rather than on the heap; the WorldSim tick advances its time every fixed step and reads it back for scheduled effects / time-limit checks.

fields.name: time
fields._doc: Simulation time in seconds, advanced by the fixed timestep (set via the vtable Set slot, read via Get).

control.name: Control
control._doc: Base UI control of the game's own widget toolkit (factory Type 'Control', alloc 0x190). RTTI hierarchy: Control -> WindowFrame -> StaticWindow -> Static/BorderedWindow; Button/Text/TextButton/EditBox/ListBox/TabbedPanel/SliderBar/DropDownMenu/Graph derive from it. Only the members confirmed through the control-tree helpers (Ui_FindControl / Ui_AddChild) are modelled here; the rest of the 0x190 bytes is unidentified.

fields.name: children
fields._doc: std::vector<Control*> of child controls (begin/end/cap at +0xD0/+0xD8/+0xE0). Walked by Ui_FindControl, mutated by Ui_AddChild/Ui_AddChildFront.

fields.name: name
fields._doc: MSVC std::string control name (SSO buffer at +0x128, size at +0x138, capacity at +0x140). Matched by Ui_FindControl and by the engine's named-control lookups (e.g. DebugPanel, ResourcePanelEnemy); used as the first argument to the Lua UI functions.

fields.name: flag_148
fields._doc: Unknown flag. Ui_FindControl only descends into a control's children when this is 0 (or when a recursive lookup was requested), so it gates child lookup/visibility.

node.name: Node
node._doc: A simulation node (forts are graphs of nodes linked by struts). These are the elements of the WorldSim node vector at sim+0x30 (std::vector<Node*>, 8 bytes per slot; slots 0 and 1 are the reserved null/sentinel entries, real nodes start at index 2). This is a PACKED (4-byte) MSVC class, so its pointers and link vector live at 4-mod-8 offsets the field vocabulary cannot express; only the naturally-aligned scalars are modelled here. Verified live against the game's own world-dump: node id, team, mass, drag, x/y/z position, x/y velocity and structure id all match. NodeVelocity/NodePosition/NodeTeam/NodeStructureId in the Lua API read these. `projectile` is a pointer at +0xBC (null unless the node is a projectile); `controller` is a pointer at +0xC4 (the Device/Weapon attached to the node, null otherwise); the link vector is a std::vector<Link> control block at +0xCC/+0xD4/+0xDC with 0x19C-byte packed Link elements.

fields.name: node_id
fields._doc: Node id used by the Lua API (NodeExists/NodePosition/...). Verified live: matches the 'N%d' line of the world dump.

fields.name: team_id
fields._doc: Owning team id (encoded side+team: side = team_id % 100). 0 for a free/neutral node. Verified live.

fields.name: mass
fields._doc: Node mass in kg (world dump 'Mass'). Verified live.

fields.name: drag
fields._doc: Per-node air drag (world dump 'Drag'; scaled by Physics.AirDrag). Verified live.

fields.name: position_x
fields._doc: World position X (float; Lua NodePosition). Verified live.

fields.name: position_y
fields._doc: World position Y (float; Lua NodePosition). Verified live.

fields.name: position_z
fields._doc: World position Z (float; Lua NodePosition). Verified live.

fields.name: velocity_x
fields._doc: Velocity X (float; Lua NodeVelocity). Verified live.

fields.name: velocity_y
fields._doc: Velocity Y (float; Lua NodeVelocity). Verified live.

fields.name: structure_id
fields._doc: Structure this node belongs to (Lua NodeStructureId / GetStructureId). -1 when unassigned. Verified live.

fields.name: prev_position_x
fields._doc: Position X at the previous step (world dump 'Prev'). Verified live.

fields.name: prev_position_y
fields._doc: Position Y at the previous step (world dump 'Prev'). Verified live.

terrain.name: TerrainManager
terrain._doc: World+0x1CC0. Terrain + global physics-constant holder, built by World_ctor via its ctor FUN_1401fb780, which reads the config registry (config object = World+0x140) for the 'Physics.*' constants and caches the resolved values here. Read these to inspect the live physics tuning (Lua GetConstant('Physics.Gravity')). Verified live.

fields.name: gravity
fields._doc: Resolved Physics.Gravity (vertical force, positive down; default 982.4). Verified live: 981.
